title: Packing Detail Before the Noun
grammar: Left-branching word order in Hungarian participial modifiers
goal: I can order multiple modifiers (place, time, manner, object) inside a pre-nominal participial phrase.
I can keep the determiner ('a/az', 'egy') at the left edge and the head noun at the right edge of the bracket.
I can read and construct multi-layered sensory descriptions of places and characters.
